summary: Test only: fractal-api-core's export_read_loan_writer_wait_holds_no_reader checked for held readers 50 ms after the export started. On a loaded host the export was still in its sealing and snapshot reads, with a reader checked out. It now checks once the export is waiting for the writer, running in its own process so that only this export can be counted as waiting.
